verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at docs.cdp.coinbase.com that indexes the full developer documentation. The x402 docs are also served as agent-friendly .md pages that link back to that llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed directly at them. missing for 10: an x402-specific llms.txt (the found file is CDP-wide, and none was shown on x402.org), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
